scope: Host P3 no-edge operation engine, bounded WAMR workers, restricted inert artifact/guest ABI, real UDP/artifact integration and approved schema-3 fixture migration.
status: Host slice verified; P3 remains open for ESP32 runtime adapter and physical qualification.

runtime.profile: Linux x86_64 classic interpreter with thread manager; no guest threads, WASI/libc, AOT/JIT, shared memory or implicit startup.
runtime.synchronization_fix: Exact-match correction in a generated thread_manager.c: serialize final exec-env list removal with concurrent cluster lookup; release cluster lock before destroying cluster under global list lock. Dependency checkout unchanged.
runtime.ownership: One retained access ticket from artifact dispatch until actual worker disposal acceptance. Artifact and arena charged until freed; other accesses must drain before disposal. Persistent native stacks/global arena and OS overhead are separate host infrastructure.

c.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer and LeakSanitizer; graph_wamr alone sets ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_stack_use_after_return=0 due to pinned WAMR native-stack address checks. WAMR and adapter code instrumented; deterministic core tests retain default fake-stack settings.

python.command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/kaos-p3-uv-cache PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 KAOS_P2_HOST=/tmp/kaos-p3-build/core/kaos_p2_host KAOS_P3_HOST=/tmp/kaos-p3-build/core/kaos_p3_host KAOS_P3_GUEST=/tmp/kaos-p3-build/node.wasm uv --directory ../sim_env run --offline python -m unittest discover -s tests
python.notes: All nine new P3 process cases passed; 20 pre-existing opt-in integration cases skipped. Only P3 child hosts disable ASan fake stacks. Final subsequent import-spacing-only Ruff correction changes no test behavior.

thread_sanitizer.result: All runtime lifecycle cases and 200 concurrent cross-node cancellation/disposal cycles passed with no warnings. Original upstream race was reproduced before correction.
thread_sanitizer.limits: One launch failed before main with unexpected memory mapping; subsequent exact-source run passed. ThreadSanitizer is sampling evidence, not proof of race freedom.
thread_sanitizer.runner: Python runner retries only a ThreadSanitizer unexpected-memory-mapping failure before main; all other failures stop immediately.

model.outcome: No errors; complete finite state space and temporal properties checked.
model.assumptions: Live host; fair monotonic deadline advancement and control service; eventual worker completion, cancellation/termination, disposal, and access drainage. No INIT emission, successful preparation, removal authorization or delivery assumption. No physical latency bound.
model.limits: Finite hand-written abstraction; no machine-checked C refinement, WAMR memory/interrupt verification, ESP32 measurement, replacement-slot identity reuse, channels or aggregate ACK/eviction. Shared local cleanup modeled once per instance; individual creator/removal report records and deadline values remain concrete engine-test obligations. Historical success denotes creator startup.

witness.purpose: Reachable pending INIT followed by actual exit before acceptance. Intentional negated-witness invariant violation in temporary one-node copy, not a production safety failure.

model.sandbox: Initial sandbox TLC run failed to create local Java RMI socket. Approved unsandboxed final run completed successfully. Earlier draft run was deliberately stopped to align final worker/removal/deadline guards.

esp32.result: Shared engine and foundation firmware cross-build passed with ESP-IDF 5.5 / Xtensa GCC14.2.0. Firmware fixture executes foundations only; no WAMR target port or hardware execution claimed.

style: Ruff lint and format checks passed on four changed/new Python test files; git diff --check passed.
test_changes: Existing tests changed only under explicit approval for schema-3 field/constructor/wire migration. All P3 behavior cases, guests and NodeRuntime model/configuration are new.
limits: Linux host runtime only; ESP32 worker/interrupt/allocator adaptation still required.
No physical native-stack, heap/flash/overlap, radio or deadline/scheduling measurements.
ASan stack-use-after-return checking disabled specifically for runtime execution; other selected sanitizer checks remain enabled.
Finite TLC abstraction does not model WAMR internals, slot reuse or independent creator/removal deadline values; concrete tests cover those lifecycle boundaries.
P4 endpoint execution, P5 multi-channel addition, P6 full distributed removal and P7 collector/ACK/eviction remain future work.
Q05 post-retirement replay limitation and trusted first-main-entry INIT convention remain unchanged.
